title: Smooth Itô formula at the terminal horizon
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Smooth Itô formula at the terminal horizon. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: For the actual Euclidean process built from initialized progressive time integrals and completed stochastic integrals, suppose its path lies in a compact K throughout the horizon almost surely. A scalar test twice continuously Fréchet differentiable at every point of K satisfies the terminal Itô identity almost surely, with the genuine completed derivative martingale starting at zero.
